items.note: ds-dropdown removed; ds-select is the canonical select-only picker (CVA, invalid+hint, required/optional, per-option icons, readOnly). After the selector rename also apply dropdown-error-input-rename and dropdown-option-groups-fold (separate items).
On elements migrated from ds-dropdown to ds-select: [error] -> [invalid] (and static error="..." -> invalid="...").

[optionGroups]="groups" is gone on ds-select — pass groups inline in [options]: SelectItem = SelectOption | SelectOptionGroup, so merge the flat options and the groups into one [options] array (order = desired render order).
items.verify: No ds-select binds optionGroups; the groups sit inside [options] in render order.

ds-search's inner input class renamed (over-generic .input let consumer global styles leak in). Only consumer STYLING that targeted the undocumented internal class is affected — scope strictly to selectors under ds-search.

Trigger is now an editable masked text input by default (allowInput defaults true) with a trailing calendar icon, and the field sizes to CONTENT width (was full-width). Pass [allowInput]="false" for the old click-only field; set a width on the host to stretch. Usually no code change — flag for visual review (eyeball).
items.restore: [allowInput]="false" for the click-only field, plus a width on the host to stretch it
items.verify: Every date picker either takes the editable masked trigger at content width, or says otherwise with [allowInput]="false" and a width.

items.note: The selected-date/value display now defaults to `en-US` formatting via the new `locale` input (effective locale = [locale] ?? provideDsConfig datePicker.locale ?? 'en-US'), replacing the previous ambient browser `toLocaleDateString()`. A consumer whose users run a non-US browser locale (en-GB, de, fr, ...) will see a silently DIFFERENT date format with no markup change. To restore OS/ambient-driven display, set `[locale]` per instance or `provideDsConfig({ datePicker: { locale } })` app-wide.
items.restore: [locale] per picker, or provideDsConfig({ datePicker: { locale: '<bcp47>' } })
items.verify: A screen whose readers are not en-US sets the locale rather than inheriting the new default.

items.note: Default max-width changed 320px -> none (ds-search now stretches like the rest of the field family). If the 320px cap was relied on, set --ds-search-maxw: 320px on the host/theme. Usually visual-review only.
items.restore: --ds-search-maxw: 320px on the host or the theme
items.verify: Every search box is meant to stretch with its container, or pins the old 320px cap.

items.note: ds-card with the pre-existing `elevation="interactive"` value is now natively keyboard-activatable (Enter/Space trigger the click, with role="button" + tabindex) — new runtime behavior on existing markup. If a consumer hand-rolled a keyboard workaround (a custom (keydown.enter)/(keydown.space) that also fires the action), it now DOUBLE-fires with the native activation — remove the workaround. Cards without elevation="interactive", and consumers who never faked keyboard activation, need no action.
items.verify: No interactive card carries a hand-rolled keyboard activation beside the built-in one - two handlers on one card fire twice.

informational: New ds-time-picker (24h/12h via provideDsConfig, range mode, CVA) — additive.
